additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368870-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / ND 170000126] Charging Session terminated CRM:00921000974
additional_info.body:
Hello Itai,
Greetings of the day!
When we checked this charger logs, we found that local authorization is not enabled on this charger.
Backend has to make all these highlighted parameters "True" and then he has to send list of all whitelisted RFID list through backend, Maximum supported length is 100.
When we checked the list of whitelisted RFIDs, we did not find any because list is empty.
That's the reason the authorization did not happen when charger is offline.
Let us know if this backend has already been integrated with Sicharge D or not, if not, need to do backend integration for more detailed troubleshooting. And the charger is also out of warranty.
Please let us know if you have any other queries or can we close this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Beerpal Singh
